subject.title: feat(skills): publish large bundles via staged upload

question: Should ClawHub accept a new public staged-upload route and multipart fields for skill publishing, or require a different wire protocol before this PR proceeds?
rationale: The PR changes the public publish API contract; code review can identify safety defects, but maintainers need to choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Adopt package-shaped staged skill upload
options.body: Proceed with this endpoint and field shape after the size-limit defect, release-owned changelog edit, and real behavior proof gap are fixed.

options.title: Revise the wire protocol first
options.body: Ask for a different request shape or route naming before treating the implementation as the canonical skill publish API.

options.title: Defer staged skill publishing
options.body: Keep the skill publish API inline-only for now and track large-bundle publishing as a separate product/API design item.

recommendation.title: Adopt package-shaped staged skill upload
recommendation.body: Proceed with this endpoint and field shape after the size-limit defect, release-owned changelog edit, and real behavior proof gap are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the nearest recent staged publish work and is already requested for review on this PR.
